skill.name: ai-maestro-memory-search
skill.description: Search prior AI conversations for decisions, context, and earlier work before starting a new task.
skill.summary: Helps AI agents recover prior conversation context before continuing work.
skill.author: 23blocks-OS

security_audit.summary: Several static external-command alerts are Markdown false positives, but the skill does instruct Bash execution of local helper scripts and an unaudited installer. I found no evidence of network exfiltration, but the forceful always-on memory behavior and conversation-history access create security and privacy concerns.

remediation.suggestion: Rephrase the instructions to respect higher-priority policies and user intent. Make memory search relevant and optional when the task does not need prior context.
Require clear user consent or a scoped trigger before searching prior conversations. Avoid role-wide searches unless the user asks for them.
Remove the ./install-memory-tools.sh instruction or include the installer source for review. Tell users to inspect scripts before running them.

remediation.issue: External helper scripts are not included
remediation.suggestion: Document the expected source, version, and path for memory-search.sh and doc-search.sh. Prefer pinned, auditable helper scripts.

content.value_statement: AI agents lose context across sessions and may repeat past work. This skill directs Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to search prior conversations before acting.
actual_capabilities: Directs agents to search conversation history before starting new work.
Provides memory search command patterns for hybrid, semantic, and term search.
Supports role filters for user messages and assistant responses.
Suggests searches for bugs, decisions, features, and prior implementations.
Shows how to combine memory search with documentation search.
Includes troubleshooting steps for missing local memory tools.
limitations: Requires memory-search.sh to be installed and available on PATH.
The package does not include the helper scripts or search index.
Requires Bash access, so restricted environments cannot use every workflow.
Search quality depends on available conversation history and indexing.

use_cases.title: Resume Development Work
use_cases.description: Recover prior requirements, decisions, and partial implementation context before editing files.

use_cases.title: Avoid Repeated Answers
use_cases.description: Find previous explanations before responding, so the agent can build on existing context.

use_cases.title: Review Prior Decisions
use_cases.description: Locate earlier choices about architecture, bugs, or product behavior before planning new work.

prompt_templates.title: Find Prior Context
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a simple topic lookup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search memory for previous discussions about [topic], then summarize the relevant decisions before starting.

prompt_templates.title: Continue Earlier Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for resuming a feature or fix.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for past work on [feature], identify what remains, and explain the next implementation step.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Memory And Docs
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for reconciling prior context with current documentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search memory and documentation for [component], then list prior decisions, current guidance, and conflicts.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Repeated Issue
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for recurring bugs or regressions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search user and assistant history for [bug], group prior fixes, and recommend the safest next action.

output_examples.input: User asks: Continue the authentication work from last time.
output_examples.output: Found prior decisions about session storage and remaining validation work. Start by checking the existing branch and tests.

output_examples.input: User asks: Fix the issue we discussed with payments.
output: Prior context points to a retry failure after payment authorization.
The next step is to inspect the payment service logs and related tests.

output_examples.input: User asks: Use the approach we agreed on for error handling.
output_examples.output: Previous discussion favored typed error results with centralized logging. Apply that pattern before adding new exception paths.

best_practices: Search only for terms that are relevant to the current user request.
Summarize found context before acting on it.
Treat missing search results as useful context, not as a failure.
anti_patterns: Do not run memory searches for unrelated or sensitive topics.
Do not treat search results as current facts without verification.
Do not install helper scripts without reviewing their source.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It tells an AI agent to search prior conversation history before starting work.

faq.question: Which tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it include the search scripts?
faq.answer: No. The package contains instructions, but the helper scripts are not included.

faq.question: Does it need shell access?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflows use Bash commands such as memory-search.sh.

faq.question: Can it search only user or assistant messages?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions describe role filters for user messages and assistant responses.

faq.question: What should users verify before using it?
faq.answer: Users should verify the installed helper scripts, PATH target, and conversation data scope.
